test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A can do 75% of the work in 30 days while B can do 50% of the same work in 18 days. If they work together, what fraction of the work will be done in 1 day?
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Find total days for **A** and **B**: **A** = 30 × (100/75) = 40 days, **B** = 18 × (100/50) = 36 days.

Combined 1-day work fraction = (A + B) ÷ (A × B)

Combined 1-day work = (40 + 36) ÷ (40 × 36) = 76 ÷ 1440 = 19/360.

**∴ The correct answer is 19/360.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**A** does 75% (3/4) work in 30 days.

**B** does 50% (1/2) work in 18 days.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Time taken by **A** to complete 100% work = 30 × (4/3) = **40 days**

⇒ Time taken by **B** to complete 100% work = 18 × 2 = **36 days**

⇒ Let **Total Work** be the LCM of 40 and 36.

 
 

 **Person**
 **Total Days**
 **Total Work (LCM)**
 **Efficiency (Units/Day)**
 
 

 **A**
 40
 360 units
 360 ÷ 40 = **9**
 
 

 **B**
 36
 360 ÷ 36 = **10**
 
 

⇒ Combined **Efficiency** of (A + B) = 9 + 10 = **19 units/day**

⇒ Fraction of work done in 1 day = Combined Efficiency ÷ Total Work

⇒ Fraction = 19 ÷ 360 = **19/360**

**∴ The correct answer is 19/360.**

**__Additional Information__**

Efficiency and Time Relationship

The **Efficiency** of a person is inversely proportional to the **Time** taken to complete the work (Efficiency = 1 ÷ Time).

Combined Work Formula

If **A** can do a piece of work in 'x' days and **B** can do it in 'y' days, then together they can finish it in (x × y) ÷ (x + y) days.

Work Fraction

If a person completes a work in **n** days, the part of work done in 1 day is **1/n**.</p
